method: Editorial screening backed by the per-record source verification and candidate screening registries; quality thresholds take precedence over country targets.
rejection_policy: duplicate event or duplicate source URL
no stable direct original-article URL or publication date
sports, entertainment, lifestyle, local incident, or insufficient national policy relevance
core fact could not be corroborated to publication standard

hungary.remaining_gap: insufficient additional direct, date-verifiable national-policy articles without party-commentary duplication

poland.remaining_gap: quality threshold retained; three more items would be needed for the minimum target

czechia.remaining_gap: direct article and exact-date evidence constrained further inclusion

slovenia.remaining_gap: three more non-duplicative national-policy items would be needed

croatia.remaining_gap: many candidates were roundups, local incidents, or lacked distinct direct article evidence

austria.remaining_gap: systematic second pass added seven records, but fewer than fifteen met all evidence and relevance gates

germany.remaining_gap: exact-window direct-source results remained below target

romania.remaining_gap: publicly accessible direct articles with exact dates remained sparse

slovakia.remaining_gap: second pass added two records; indexed exact-window results remained insufficient and many candidates lacked stable evidence

serbia.remaining_gap: date-verifiable, directly accessible national-policy reporting remained insufficient

actor_field_audit.finding: toEventRecord currently falls back to sourceLabel when an explicit event actor is absent, so actor may contain a publisher name.
actor_field_audit.decision: Do not change only this refresh and create mixed semantics across the event library; source_name remains the authoritative publisher field and a future schema migration must address actor consistently.

notes: Reuters URLs may return an automated-access response while remaining canonical direct article URLs.
No item enters a causal model; news records remain descriptive event-library entries.
The existing event schema has no separate original-title, updated-at, or related-country field, so the update does not invent parallel fields.
